issues.text: The first-screen limit of criterion 6 rests on the design report's estimate (block near y 540 in ru at 390x844). A longer en or kk intro can push it lower; the limit is the window height 844, so there is about 300 px of slack. If the look description changes the order of how.html, criterion 6 must be amended in a micro-amendment, not weakened.

The pass 'landing with Не знаю on storage' depends on the engine data: today the answer is recommended (landing, card-site). The criterion says that a pass that stops being recommended is replaced by another recommended one, not dropped.

The row text 'K из N' shows the whole part of the count (4 of 5 for 4.5) and the half pip shows the skipped answer; the criterion states this as demo.js does it. If the owner wants '4,5 из 5', that is a change of demo_k_of_n and of the code, not of this rework.
